text: You are an on-site service engineer for industrial pumping equipment. A customer reports that a centrifugal feed pump trips the overload relay about forty seconds after start-up, and the discharge pressure stays below the normal operating band during that window. Answer as a short checklist: first state the two most likely causes with the physical reasoning behind each, then give a three-step field test that separates mechanical binding from an electrical supply problem, then say which measurement you would log first and why. Keep every item under twenty words, use plain field language rather than textbook wording, and do not invent part numbers or torque values that were not given.
